function.name: escalateToOnCall
function.description: Immediately notifies the on-call technician or attorney via SMS when the AI detects an emergency. Use only when urgency_level is 'emergency'. After calling this tool, tell the caller the on-call team has been notified and will call them back within 15 minutes.

service_address.description: The address where the emergency is occurring.

issue_description.description: Brief description of the emergency (e.g. 'burst pipe flooding kitchen', 'sewage backup in basement').

industry.description: The industry vertical so the right on-call team is notified.
